name: issuing-documented

limit.unit: USD cents (the card's smallest currency unit)
limit.name: a cardholder's spending_limits entry, interval daily

quotes.text: Spending aggregation is done on a best-effort basis.
You might notice a delay of up to 30 seconds between spend occurrence and spend aggregation.
Additional tips and fees can be posted at a later time, causing a spending limit to be exceeded.
Spending limit rules limit the total amount of spending for categories over intervals of time.

reads_as: Aggregation on a best-effort basis, up to 30 seconds behind the spend (quotes 0 and 1): Lag 1 and Atomic false, the record's values.
Tips and fees posted later, taking spend past the limit (quote 2): over-capture on. The documents give no figure; 20 percent of the hold is assumed.

The limit counts the total spending over its interval (quote 3): the face is the record's daily limit, 10000 minor units; the daily interval is a calendar period the card ledger does not tell apart from a sliding one.
Force-posts (a capture with no authorization) are not in the documents quoted, so the profile leaves them off; a profile that measures them adds ForcePost.
